props.name: suffix
props.description: Text after the number, like "%" or "k".

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each digit takes to settle. Digits further left start slightly later.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Roll in when scrolled into view. Turn off to roll immediately.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element. Set the size with a text-size class.
